description: MAINFRAME Structured Error Catalog - All modules

E_FILE_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Use file_exists to check before accessing, or ensure_file to create with defaults

E_FILE_EXISTS.suggestion: Use ensure_file for idempotent creation, or atomic_replace for overwrite

E_PERMISSION_DENIED.suggestion: Check file permissions with stat or guard_file_op before access

E_WRITE_FAILED.suggestion: Verify directory exists and is writable. Use ensure_dir for parent directory

E_READ_FAILED.suggestion: Check file exists and has read permissions

E_DIR_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Use ensure_dir to create directory if missing

E_DIR_NOT_EMPTY.suggestion: Use safe_remove for recoverable deletion or verify contents first

E_DISK_FULL.suggestion: Check disk space before write operations with guard_disk_space

E_PATH_TRAVERSAL.suggestion: Use validate_path_safe or path_is_safe to prevent directory traversal attacks

E_PATH_UNSAFE.suggestion: Use validate_path_chars to check or path_sanitize to clean the path

E_PATH_NOT_ABSOLUTE.suggestion: Use path_absolute to resolve relative paths

E_PATH_SYMLINK.suggestion: Use guard_symlink with reject policy or path_resolve to follow safely

E_INVALID_EMAIL.suggestion: Use validate_email before processing email input

E_INVALID_INT.suggestion: Use validate_int with min/max bounds or guard_integer for range check

E_INVALID_FLOAT.suggestion: Use validate_float to verify numeric format

E_INVALID_URL.suggestion: Use validate_url with scheme check before HTTP operations

E_INVALID_IP.suggestion: Use validate_ipv4 or validate_ipv6 to check address format

E_INVALID_PORT.suggestion: Use validate_port to verify port is in valid range

E_INVALID_DATE.suggestion: Use validate_date to verify format before date operations

E_INVALID_SEMVER.suggestion: Use validate_semver or parse_semver for version strings

E_INVALID_UUID.suggestion: Use validate_uuid to check format, or uuid to generate valid UUID

E_INVALID_BOOL.suggestion: Use validate_bool to check valid boolean representations

E_INVALID_JSON.suggestion: Use validate_json or json_valid to check JSON before parsing

E_LENGTH_VIOLATION.suggestion: Use validate_length to verify string length constraints

E_ENUM_VIOLATION.suggestion: Use validate_enum to check against permitted values

E_INJECTION_DETECTED.suggestion: Use sanitize_shell_arg for shell, sanitize_sql for SQL, or sanitize_html for HTML

E_JSON_PARSE.suggestion: Verify JSON syntax with json_valid before parsing with json_get

E_JSON_KEY_NOT_FOUND.message: Key not found in JSON object: {key}
E_JSON_KEY_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Use json_keys to list available keys before accessing

E_JSON_TYPE_MISMATCH.message: JSON type mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual} for key {key}
E_JSON_TYPE_MISMATCH.suggestion: Use json_object type modifiers (key:number=, key:bool=) for typed output

E_RISK_BLOCKED.message: Operation blocked: risk score {score}/10 exceeds threshold {threshold}
E_RISK_BLOCKED.suggestion: Use mainframe_risk_assess to understand why. Lower risk by targeting safer paths or removing dangerous flags

E_RISK_THRESHOLD.message: Operation requires confirmation: risk score {score}/10 at confirm threshold {threshold}
E_RISK_THRESHOLD.suggestion: Use mainframe_risk_assess for details, then confirm or use atomic operations for safety

E_RISK_CATASTROPHIC.suggestion: ABORT immediately. This operation could destroy system data. Use sandboxed environment

E_SCOPE_VIOLATION.message: Scope violation ({scope_type}): {target} not in allowed scope [{allowed}]
E_SCOPE_VIOLATION.suggestion: Check scope with mainframe_scope_check or expand scope with mainframe_scope_set

E_SCOPE_NOT_SET.message: No scope defined for type: {scope_type}. All operations allowed (open scope)
E_SCOPE_NOT_SET.suggestion: Set explicit scope boundaries with mainframe_scope_set for safety

E_SCOPE_INVALID_TYPE.message: Invalid scope type: {type} (valid: filesystem, network, commands)
E_SCOPE_INVALID_TYPE.suggestion: Use one of the valid scope types: filesystem, network, commands

E_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.suggestion: Review resource usage and reduce operations or increase limits

E_LIMIT_WRITES.suggestion: Use atomic operations to combine writes, or increase MAINFRAME_LIMIT_WRITES

E_LIMIT_TIME.suggestion: Optimize operations or use run_with_timeout for controlled execution

E_LIMIT_SIZE.suggestion: Reduce data volume or increase MAINFRAME_UNDO_MAX_SIZE / MAINFRAME_CACHE_MAX_SIZE_MB

E_CONFIRM_DENIED.suggestion: User chose not to proceed. Review the operation or lower its risk level

E_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT.suggestion: Increase timeout or use non-interactive mode for automated workflows

E_UNDO_EMPTY.message: Undo stack is empty - no operations to reverse
E_UNDO_EMPTY.suggestion: Record operations with mainframe_undo_record before attempting undo

E_UNDO_FAILED.message: Undo operation failed for step {step}: {operation} on {target}
E_UNDO_FAILED.suggestion: Check file permissions and existence. Manual recovery may be needed

E_UNDO_NO_BACKUP.message: Backup not found for undo: hash={hash}, target={target}
E_UNDO_NO_BACKUP.suggestion: Backup may have been cleaned. Check MAINFRAME_UNDO_DIR for backup files

E_UNDO_SIZE_LIMIT.message: Undo backup storage limit reached: {current} bytes (max: {max} bytes)
E_UNDO_SIZE_LIMIT.suggestion: Increase MAINFRAME_UNDO_MAX_SIZE or reduce number of tracked operations

E_UNDO_DISABLED.suggestion: Set MAINFRAME_UNDO_ENABLED=1 to enable operation tracking

E_STATE_EMPTY.message: Plan is empty - no steps to execute or display
E_STATE_EMPTY.suggestion: Add steps with mainframe_plan_add before showing or executing

E_PLAN_FAILED.message: Plan execution failed at step {step}: {command} (exit code: {exit_code})
E_PLAN_FAILED.suggestion: Review the failed step with mainframe_plan_show. Use file_checkpoint before risky plans

E_PLAN_RISK_HIGH.suggestion: Review with mainframe_plan_show. Consider dry-run mode first (MAINFRAME_DRY_RUN=1)

E_ARG_MISSING.suggestion: Provide all required arguments. Use contract_not_empty to validate

E_ARG_INVALID.suggestion: Check argument constraints with contract_type_check or contract_in_range

E_AGENT_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Verify agent ID exists. List registered agents before sending messages

E_AGENT_TIMEOUT.suggestion: Increase timeout or check if agent process is still running

E_AGENT_QUEUE_FULL.suggestion: Process pending messages or increase queue capacity

E_QUEUE_EMPTY.message: Work queue is empty - no items to process
E_QUEUE_EMPTY.suggestion: Push work items before attempting to pop from queue

E_BARRIER_TIMEOUT.message: Agent barrier timeout: {arrived}/{expected} agents arrived in {timeout}s
E_BARRIER_TIMEOUT.suggestion: Check if all agents are running. Increase barrier timeout

E_WF_CYCLE.suggestion: Remove circular dependencies between workflow steps

E_WF_DEP_MISSING.message: Workflow dependency not found: step {step} depends on {dependency}
E_WF_DEP_MISSING.suggestion: Define all dependencies before referencing them in workflow steps

E_WF_STEP_FAILED.suggestion: Check step output and retry, or define error handler in workflow

E_WF_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Define workflow before running. Check workflow ID is correct

E_WF_ALREADY_RUNNING.suggestion: Wait for current execution to complete or use a different workflow instance

E_CACHE_MISS.suggestion: Normal behavior on first call. Function will be executed and result cached

E_CACHE_EXPIRED.suggestion: Increase TTL with --ttl flag on memoize, or re-invoke function

E_CACHE_FULL.suggestion: Run cache_evict_lru to remove old entries, or increase MAINFRAME_CACHE_MAX_SIZE_MB

E_CACHE_LOCK_FAILED.message: Failed to acquire cache lock for key: {key} (timeout after 10s)
E_CACHE_LOCK_FAILED.suggestion: Another process may be computing this value. Wait and retry

E_CACHE_HASH_FAILED.message: SHA-256 hash computation failed (no sha256sum, shasum, or openssl available)
E_CACHE_HASH_FAILED.suggestion: Install sha256sum (coreutils) or openssl for cache operations

E_NET_TIMEOUT.suggestion: Increase timeout, check network connectivity, or verify host/port

E_NET_REFUSED.suggestion: Verify service is running on target host and port

E_HOST_UNREACHABLE.suggestion: Check network connectivity, DNS resolution, and firewall rules

E_HTTP_ERROR.suggestion: Check URL, authentication, and request parameters

E_DNS_FAILED.suggestion: Verify hostname spelling, DNS server availability, and /etc/resolv.conf

E_DOCKER_NOT_RUNNING.suggestion: Start Docker daemon with 'systemctl start docker' or 'dockerd'

E_CONTAINER_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Check container name with docker_containers_all. Container may need to be created

E_CONTAINER_NOT_RUNNING.message: Container exists but is not running: {name} (status: {status})

E_DOCKER_PORT_CONFLICT.message: Port {port} already in use by container: {container}
E_DOCKER_PORT_CONFLICT.suggestion: Stop conflicting container or use a different port

E_COMPOSE_FAILED.message: Docker Compose operation failed for service: {service}
E_COMPOSE_FAILED.suggestion: Check compose file syntax and service logs with compose_logs

E_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Pull the image with docker_image_pull or check image name/tag

E_CONTRACT_VIOLATED.suggestion: Fix the calling code to satisfy the contract precondition/postcondition

E_TYPE_MISMATCH.suggestion: Use contract_type_check to validate types: int, float, bool, string, file, dir, path

E_PRECONDITION_FAILED.suggestion: Ensure all inputs satisfy preconditions before calling function

E_POSTCONDITION_FAILED.suggestion: Function completed but output invariant was violated. Debug implementation

E_OBSERVE_TIMEOUT.suggestion: Increase timeout or optimize the command

E_TRACE_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Ensure trace_start was called and ID was captured correctly

E_ENV_NOT_SET.suggestion: Set the variable with env_set or export, or add to .env file

E_ENV_INVALID.suggestion: Check variable format. Use env_get_int or env_get_bool for typed access

E_LOCK_TIMEOUT.suggestion: Another process holds the lock. Wait or check for stale lock files

E_LOCK_STALE.message: Stale lock file detected: {lockfile} (owner PID {pid} not running)
E_LOCK_STALE.suggestion: Remove stale lock with lockfile_release and retry

E_PROCESS_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Process may have exited. Use proc_find_by_name or proc_find_by_port

E_TIMEOUT.suggestion: Increase timeout value or optimize the operation

E_RETRY_EXHAUSTED.suggestion: Check underlying failure cause. Consider longer backoff or alternative approach

E_STRICT_MODE.message: Command failed in strict mode (set -e): {command} at {file}:{line}
E_STRICT_MODE.suggestion: Use unsafe_run for commands that may fail non-fatally, or handle error explicitly

E_SOURCE_FAILED.suggestion: Check file exists and has valid bash syntax. Use safe_source for graceful handling

E_COMMAND_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Install the missing command. Use guard_command with install hint

E_OS_UNSUPPORTED.suggestion: This script requires a specific OS. Check compatibility

E_MEMORY_LOW.suggestion: Free memory by stopping unnecessary processes or reduce operation scope

E_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: Create config file or specify correct path with config_load

E_CONFIG_PARSE.message: Failed to parse configuration: {path} at line {line}
E_CONFIG_PARSE.suggestion: Check config file syntax. Use parse_key_value or parse_ini for structured parsing

E_CSV_PARSE.suggestion: Check CSV format: proper quoting, consistent delimiters. Use csv_validate first

E_CRYPTO_NO_TOOL.message: No cryptographic tool available (need sha256sum, shasum, or openssl)

E_PERF_TIMER_NOT_STARTED.suggestion: Call perf_timer_start before perf_timer_elapsed or perf_timer_stop

E_BASH_VERSION.suggestion: Upgrade bash or use feature-gated code paths with bash_has_feature

E_ATOMIC_VERIFY_FAILED.message: Atomic replace verification failed: {verify_cmd} returned non-zero
E_ATOMIC_VERIFY_FAILED.suggestion: The verification command rejected the new content. Original file was preserved

E_CHECKPOINT_NOT_FOUND.suggestion: List available checkpoints with file_checkpoints before rollback

E_PROJECT_NOT_DETECTED.message: Could not detect project type in: {path}
E_PROJECT_NOT_DETECTED.suggestion: Ensure project has standard files (package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod, etc.)

E_FUNCTIONAL_EMPTY_INPUT.suggestion: Provide at least one element for map/filter/reduce operations
